raw_text: TIH with drilling BHA to 9 5/8" window. Corrected problem w/yellow pod tested bops. Attempted to drill-got stuck freed string. Unable to pass back through window. POOH PU milling BHA.

Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 2771-2783 m not making progress. POOH for bit/bha change got stuck while preparing to pull through window. Fight lost returns/tight hole. Successful in pulling through window. Finished POOH. Test bops.
Operations suspended due to industrial action. Continued RIH with logging tools on drill pipe. Pipe stuck with logging tools at 4123m. Worked pipe. POOH with wireline.
Finished POOH with wireline. Freed stuck pipe. POOH and l/d logging tools. RIH for wiper trip to condition hole for running 7" casing.
Retrived 7" CSG. Set wear bushing and RIH to set kick off plug. Circ hole in CSG window.
Circulated gas level down. RIH and set kick off plug. POOH and laid down excess 3 1/2" DP and 4 3/4" DC'S
RIH with coring assembly. While reaming down from 3680m string became stuck momentarily at 3772m and 3842m. POOH and racked backed coring assembly. P/u rotary drilling assembly. W. O. W.
Finished reaming from 4130m to 4139m to aqcuire better MWD log. Drilled from 4139m to 4250m. Circulated bottoms up and boosted riser. POOH for wiper trip. Pipe stuck at 4094m. Worked stuck pipe.
Freed stuck pipe. Finished POOH. R/u AWS and ran wireline logs from 7" casing shoe 1st run mac/gr, 2nd run VSP.

Continued pick up 5" DP and RIH. Wash CMT traces to CSG window. Driller hit wooden beams underneath crown blocks. Removed wood and inspect crown blocks hrs repair time) dress CMT and performed kick off from 2231m to 2277m.
Washed down from 2651m to 2920m. Washed and drilled soft to firm cement from 2920m to 3054m. Drilled 8 1/2" hole from 3054m to 3212m. No mud losses.
Completed POOH with sidetrack BHA. TIH to set sidetrack plug breaking circulation circulating as needed. Set sidetrack plug from 2983 2835 m with 0,5 m3 of mud loss. POOH with stinger.
Drilled/surveyed 12 1/4" hole from 2938m to 3018m. Backreamed to 2957m. Hole packed off. Lost circulation. Pumped LCM-PILL. Reestablished circulation. Started backreaming OOH.
Backreamed to 2937, packed off, unable to rotate. Reestablished rotation and circulation. Pumped pills to clean hole. Raised mudweight to 1,45 then to 1,50 to control overpressured shales
Circulated to record/observe cuttings returns. Raised mudweight to 1,55 SG to control overpressured shales. Backreamed to 2850m.

Continued log no 1 to 9 5/8" shoe. Became stuck while performing repeat section at 3697m. Rigged up to retrieve logging tools with DP. Fed catcher through DP and RIH with overshot assy. Repaired wireline winch gear box. Continued RIH with overshot assy.

Rev circ, final shut in press 93 bar. Press tested casing/pbr NEG by bleeding off press in steps performed torque readings pumped detergent/ flocculant pills and sea water pumped 4,5 m3 1,36 SG brine and displaced with sea water POOH to 4340 m and displaced well to 1,15 SG nacl brine

Ri to 2220m, pumped 4m3 hi-vis as base for plug, placed balanced cement plug from 2180 to 1980 m and from 1850 to 1550m. POOH. Ri with clean-out assembly. Washed/reamed from 1400m, stuck at 1493m, worked pipe free. Worked tight area 1492-1495m.

Drilled 26" hole from 239 m to 246 m MD. Performed singel shot survey on WL. Reamed hole to obtain verticallity. Drilled 26" hole from 246 m to 298 m MD. Performed single shot survey on WL. Initiated kick off. Drilled and oriented 26" hole from 298 m to 390 m MD.

Made up 18 3/4" casing. Attmepted to RIH with casing negative casing was differential stuck. Displaced well from 1,40 SG mud to seawater and worked casing free. RIH with 20" casing to 1389 m MD and landed wellhead in conductor housing at 139,7 m MD. Cemented 20" casing, bumped plug and confirmed no backflow.

Wow. Attempted to perform wiper trip. Found BHA had parted with top of fish at f-11 template funnel. Recovered 115,91 m of BHA to surface. Evaluated situation and mobilized fisherman and fishing equipment to rig. Next 24 hrs fish remaining 36" BHA from well and POOH same.
Evaluated situation and planned fishing job. Completed enviro unit installation and sputted wireline unit. Next 24 hrs fish remaining 36" BHA from well.
POOH with fishing BHA, performed wiper trip and commenced running 30" conductor. Next 24 hrs. Run and cement 30" conductor.
Circulated and reduced MW to 1,28 SG. Spotted 10 m3 1,32 SG hi-vis pill. Mixed and pumped kick off plug. POOH with cement stinger. Commenced make up 12 1/4" drillng BHA.
Completed logging RST IC passes. Performed shut in PLT pass. Started to bean up well for flowing PLT passes.

Performed slip and cut of drill line. Ran washed in hole with 8 1/2" bottom hole assembly from 1609m MD and tagged hard cement with 10mt at 2573m MD Drilled cement and kicked off to f-11 a at 2586m MD.
Removed diverter. Worked on stuck lock ring on overshot joint. Pulled overshot joint. Prepared for skidding BOP.

RU WL equipment. Installed BHA into lubricator. RIH with PLT. Performed spinner calibration. Performed depth correlation with GR/CCL. Took stationary reading at 2929 m. Ran PLT shut in pass. Took stationary readings. Beaned up well. Waited for stable flow.

Stod by for rigging down WL until scheduled shut-in. Canceled cheduled production shut-in and had to wait on m rsk to finish off 5-yearly work on tension cylinders in moonpool. Waited on m rsk production to shut in well and inflow test hmvand DHSV. Drained lubricator and WL riser. Broke out lubricator and LD toolstring. Tested WL BOP to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. LD lubricator. Installed double lift

Discussed fishing alternatives and way forward. Successfully entered lost drillstring with standard DP thread, made up coupling with TDS. Worked string and found free to move. Made plans for continuing displacement to 1,44 SG OBM. Displaced well to OBM. POOH and worked through restriction at 1357 m MD. Not able to trip due to problems with ZMS system. Lined up and circulated well at 3500 LPM, took
Drilled cement in 20" casing from 1318 m to 1368 m MD. Drilled cement/new formation from 1368 m to 1381 m MD. Initiated kick off of f-15.

RIH with 8½" BHA from 1240m to 2560m. Wash down from 2560m to 3072m set down 4 MT firm cement. Attempted to kick of the cement with low drilling parameters. Increased drilling parameters and washed down from 3090 to 3141m. 60-80 cement in returns.
Drilled 8½" hole from 3141m to 3185m and kicked off at 3185m continued drilling to 3210m 50/50 cement/formation.

Washed down from 2440 m and tagged cement at 2490 m MD. MD. Displaced from 1,35 SG ot 1,25 SG OBM. Drilled cement from 2490 m to 2566 m MD. Initiated kick off and drilled 12 1/4" section down to 2575 m MD.

Bullheaded well with 188 m3 of SW. Pumped 94 m3 of 1,21 SG OBM and killed well. R/u and RIH with 5,75" drift on slickline. Troubleshoot closed DHSV/STUCK s/l toolstring. Performed drift run to 3070 m, POOH. R/d s/l and r/u wireline equipment to set EVO plug in 7" liner.

Punched tubing at 2782 m. POOH, l/d punching BHA. Circulated tubing and annulus to 1,21 SG OBM. RIH with run open DHSV) on s/l. Set lock open ring and POOH. RIH and attempted to pull FLO w/o sucess. Jarred free and POOH. Re-build toolstring and RIH to retrieve FLO. Jarred and confirmed FLO free, POOH. Lost toolstring in hole while POOH. M/u fishing BHA for fishing lost toolstring.

M/u fishing BHA, RIH and fished lost toolstring. POOH and l/d toolstring. Re-arranged fishing BHA to fish FLO, RIH and fished FLO. POOH and l/d FLO. M/u shallow set EVO plug RIH on s/l and set plug at 35 m. P/t plug to 20/240 bar for 5/10 min. N/d xmas tree on f-15. Prepared for n/u BOP, skidded BOP to well center. Installed slick joint and prepared for skidding cantilever package.

Held statoil TOFS w/ drilling crew Retrieved MS-T seal from surface wellhead. RIH w/ drilquip adjustable sub setting tool and released tension from 10 3/4" tieback string, observed string backed off. Troubleshot stuck adjustable sub tool. Decided to pull complete surface tieback string w/ drilquip tool. L/o surface hanger w/ tool and DP single. POOH and l/o 10 3/4" tieback string. R/d casing handl
Performed 13 3/8" seal assembly dummy run. Slipped and cut drill line. RIH with stinger to set kickoff plug. Circulated prior to set kickoff plug.
Set kickoff plug. Pulled wear bushing. Polished wellhead. Performed 13 3/8" seal assembly dummy run. Installed wear bushing.
RIH with 17 1/2" BHA. Drilled cement and kicked off. Drilled 17 1/2" hole.
Continued rigging up WL well control equipment and tested same. P/u perforation toolstring. RIH with same on WL to 3500 m without using tractor. Continued RIH using tractor to 4300 m.
P/u, m/u 8 1/2" drilling BHA and RIH reduced MW from 1,32 SG to 1,28 SG drilled cement in casing and rathole freed stuck string
Worked and reamed shoe and rathole. Commenced kick off to f-1a
Kicked off well from f-1 drilled and steered 8 1/2" section to 3004 m MD.
P/u and m/u 12 1/4" BHA. RIH on 5 1/2" DP. Performed choke drill. Drilled out cement and kicked off well to f-1 b.
Kicked off well from f-1 a. Drilled 12 1/4" hole through ty fm. To 2763 m.

Replaced TDS service loop and tested TDS. Set 9 5/8" safelock plug at 619 m and pressure tested same from below and above. Retrieved bowl protector. Retrieved MS-T seal assembly. RIH and engaged drilquip adjustable sub setting tool. Released tension from 10 3/4" surface tieback. Troubleshot stuck tool, released tieback adapter and POOH tieback with stuck tool inside. R/u to retrieve 10 3/4" tiebac

RIH with torque tool and m/u 10 3/4" tieback adapter. POOH. Re-ran tieback string. RIH with torque tool and m/u 10 3/4" tieback adapter. POOH. M/u adjustable sub setting tool and RIH with same. Sat hanger. Attempted to POOH with adjustable sub setting tool. No go. Attempted to free string by applying overpull. No go. Evaluated sitation and decided to release tieback adapter. Applied overpull and t
Logged three IC passes and started additional PLT shut in passes.
Completed additional PLT shut in passes. Attempted to bean up well without success. Waiting for well to flow.

RIH with MDT toolstring Positioned tool at sampling depth 3245 m MD. Took pressure point sample. Found toolstring stuck at 3245 m MD. Attempted to free stuck WL, applied MAX tension of 12000 lbs. Performed MDT fluid sampling at stuck point filled 2 x 450 cc sample bottles. Rigged up for doing cut an thread fishing operation.

Rigged up for cut and thread fishing. Made up x-over, threaded wire and picked up first singel. Made up fishing grapple and drain sub. Had to re-arrange WL sheaves due to unfavourable angle on wire. Ran in to 268 m MD with 5 1/2" DP singles over 7/48 cable according to cut and thread procedure.

POOH with 7" liner hanger RT on 5 1/2" DP from 3340 m to OOH. Inspected liner hanger RT. Found hydraulic release activated. All items intact on RT. Waiting on fishing tools to arrive from town. LD 5 1/2" DP in singles while waiting.

Lo stds of 5 1/2" DP 24. 7 lbs/ft in singles while waiting for fishing tools to arrive from town. Found that pack-off on spear assembly was wrong size. Waited on helicopter to get the correct size pack-off. RIH with spear assembly on 5 1/2" DP from 11 m to 693 m MD.

Sat liner hanger packer. Released liner hanger RT and circulated out excess cement. POOH and LD liner hanger RT with wiper plugs attached. Bo and LD fishing BHA. RU 7" CSG equipment. RIH with 7" liner stds to 738 m. POOH and lo 7" liner in singles from 738 m to 671 m.
Wow prior to pull HPDR. Shut in f12 production. Prepared for/disconnected and pulled HPDR.

RIH with adjustment sub actuation tool. Retracted adjustment sub according to drillquip procedure. Not able to come free with tool with 5 MT overpull. Discussed situation. Not able to come free with 10 MT overpull. Discussed sitaution. Reverted to contingency plan. Released and POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing with stuck tool. Broke casing connection and found tool packed with cuttings/dirt. Disc

Milled window from 423,8 m to 424,3 m with slow progress. Observed a 50 bar instant drop in SPP. Decided to pull out of hole and found 8-1/8" XO had parted, leaving 7 m of BHA mill watermelon mill) in hole. Top of fish at 417 m. Prepared and modified fishing tool overshot with extension sub and 9" grapple). Ran in hole with overshot, latched fish at 417 m and pulled out same. 12-1/4" trackmaster m
rig up WL well control equipment, pressure tested same bullheaded washpill and sea water into the well set and pressure tested deepset plug

RIH with cutter and cut 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" casing at 850 mmd. POOH with cutter. Observed gain in TT closed in well and investigated continued POOH to surface RIH with spear pulled tubing to 383 mmd. Observed gain in TT and shut in well investigated gain in TT

attempted to fish and pull 10 3/4 x 9 5/8 CSG. Engaged fish on spear but not able to pull CSG OOH. released spear, POOH RIH w/ 9 5/8 CSG cutter, cut CSG 2361m attempted to POOH, got stuck w/ cutter BHA 2362m
waited for WL cutting equipment to be mobilized. Meanwhile worked on repairing forward PRS prepared bhas for upcoming dressing and fishing runs r/u WL equipment
